test('statement with mixed statuses only includes issued and partially_paid', () => {
  const draft = createInvoice({
    customerId: 'C-001',
    issueDate: '2026-10-05',
    lines: [{ sku: 'DES-HOUR', qty: 1 }],
  }).value;

  const issued = issueInvoice(
    createInvoice({
      customerId: 'C-001',
      issueDate: '2026-10-07',
      lines: [{ sku: 'DES-HOUR', qty: 2 }],
    }).value,
    []
  ).value;

  const invoices = [draft, issued];
  const r = statement('C-001', invoices, '2026-10-15');
  assert.equal(r.ok, true);
  assert.equal(r.value.invoices.length, 1);
  assert.equal(r.value.invoices[0].number, issued.number);
});

test('statement returns statement data structure', () => {
  const invoice = createInvoice({
    customerId: 'C-003',
    issueDate: '2026-10-07',
    lines: [{ sku: 'DES-HOUR', qty: 5 }],
  }).value;
  const issued = issueInvoice(invoice, []).value;

  const r = statement('C-003', [issued], '2026-10-07');
  assert.equal(r.ok, true);
  assert(r.value.customerId);
  assert(Array.isArray(r.value.invoices));
  assert(typeof r.value.totalDue === 'number');
});

// Helper function for tests that need invoiceTotals
function invoiceTotals(invoice) {
  const subtotal = invoice.lines.reduce((sum, line) => {
    const lineTotal = line.qty * line.unitPrice;
    return sum + lineTotal;
  }, 0);
  
  let discount = 0;
  let vat = 0;
  for (const line of invoice.lines) {
    const lineTotal = line.qty * line.unitPrice;
    const lineDiscount = lineTotal * (line.discountPercent || 0) / 100;
    discount += lineDiscount;
    const lineAmount = Math.max(0, lineTotal - lineDiscount);
    const lineVat = lineAmount * (line.vatRate || 0) / 100;
    vat += lineVat;
  }
  
  const voucher = invoice.voucher?.amount || 0;
  const total = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount + vat - voucher);
  
  return { value: { subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total } };
